candidates.description: This vector represents sports, particularly ball-based games and athletic activities.
This feature vector represents terminology and entities associated with baseball and sports team personnel or positions.
This vector represents terms related to baseball terminology, teams, and divisions, alongside Japanese animation and comic culture.
This vector represents word fragments and tokens starting with the letter sequence "Nat" or "Na", along with common English and Romance roots.
This feature vector represents terms associated with sports tournaments, playoffs, and competitive events.
This vector represents tokens starting with the common prefix "Inter-" or its close phonetic and orthographic variations.
This feature vector activates on proper nouns, major organizations, and prominent brand names starting with capital letters.
The tokens represent geographical regions and continents of the world.
This vector represents names of countries and sovereign states.
